answer: We enforce Sybil resistance by coupling recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments with a sequential verifiable delay function. An adversary attempting identity cloning faces a slashing penalty that exceeds their staking collateral, forcing expected attack utility to its nadir. In this model, a decentralized wharf of validators uses the output to echo state changes, establishing a robust Nash equilibrium where any attempt to forge delay proofs guarantees immediate financial ruin, proving information-theoretic unforgeability.
